reviews.x: I love how it looks and works! Easy to apply even though I forgot to shake the liner bottle before applying and gave it a couple mins to dry. Applying the liner might take some practice but this is a must have if you want your lashes to contour to your eye shape. I did a half done half not photo then a full effect photo.

I LOVE these lashes!! I'm scared to buy another brand because these work so well. I've reused mine multiple times and slept in them and they stayed on!! I had to trim them to fit my eyes, but the magnets are spaced perfectly for trimming. These are my go to lashes now! They go on super quick and easy. Make sure you let the eyeliner dry first.

The magnets on the lash line are chunky, but also somehow also don't work? I even tried another magnetic liner I had and the magnets still wouldn't stick. reviews.t: Just Ok. Might go with another brand that's waterproof
reviews.x: The eyeliner, which is very liquidy, is easy to apply. Lashes are a little more difficult in staying on the corners of your eyes. I wore them all day and the eyeliner runs everywhere. By the end of the day, It looked like I had applied black eyeshadow. It also smudges super easily if accidentally touched. The upside is that it's easy to clean with soap and water.  I think the eyeliner ingredients could use a revamp so it doesn't smudge/run so easily IMO. I will then have no complaints

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply, even for first-time magnetic lash users.
Several reviewers praise the lashes for staying on well and being reusable over multiple wears.
Some reviewers report problems with the magnetic eyeliner, including flakiness, itchiness, heaviness, or poor performance.
A few reviewers note the lashes are very long or dramatic and may not suit smaller eyes or everyday wear.
Some reviewers mention issues with magnet placement or trimming to fit eye shape.
